note: Thesis zone id -> NRM 2011 region codes (NRMR_2011_AUST). Found by matching each zone's total area in the 2011 model to the polygon areas: 55 of 60 zones agree to within 1.5 km2 with these merges (Hawkesbury-Nepean with Sydney Metro, Murrumbidgee with ACT, Cape York with Cooperative Management Area and Torres Strait). Not in any zone: Lord Howe (111), Jervis Bay (903), Christmas Island (901), Cocos (902); the 2011 national area excludes them. Zones 32, 42, 45, 47 and 55 carry older boundaries (analysis/land_2011/README.md).
